q: How many brick kilns does Maharashtra have, what fuels do they burn and how much energy do they use?
title: Maharashtra brick kilns: fuel and energy
short: About 17,000 kilns, the most of the four states SAMEEEKSHA profiles this way, firing coal and biomass in clamps and Bull's trench kilns. They make about 28 billion bricks a year on 2.1 million toe, from December to June: the least energy per brick of the four.
audience: Brick kiln owners in Maharashtra and the Maharashtra Brick Kiln Manufacturers Association

ul: Maharashtra: 17,000 kilns, 28 billion bricks, 2.1 million toe; about 3.1 GJ per 1,000 bricks.
Haryana: 2,800 kilns, 14 billion bricks, 1.12 million toe; about 3.4 GJ.
Bihar: 6,600 kilns, 19.7 billion bricks, 2.6 million toe; about 5.5 GJ.
Andhra Pradesh: 8,000 kilns, 9.3 billion bricks, 1.37 million toe; about 6.2 GJ.

p: The average Maharashtra kiln makes about 16.5 lakh bricks a year on about 124 toe, a third of Haryana's output per kiln. Most green bricks are hand moulded; a few units use extruders. State averages hide a wide spread: a clamp and a well run trench kiln in the same district can differ by a large margin.

sections.h: Turning the average into your figure
ol: Add up a season's coal from invoices and biomass from purchase slips, by tonne.
Count bricks fired, not bricks sold.
Divide fuel by bricks for tonnes per lakh, and compare with your neighbours, not with the state.
Keep biomass on its own line as biogenic.

example.title: An average Maharashtra kiln (estimate)
lines: Energy: 2.1 million toe / 17,000 = 124 toe a year
Ceiling if all coal: 124 x 41.868 GJ x 94.6 kg = about 490 t CO2 a year, or about 300 kg per 1,000 bricks
example.note: Totals from SAMEEEKSHA's state brick pages for Maharashtra, Haryana, Bihar and Andhra Pradesh. The ceiling uses the IPCC 2006 default for bituminous coal; biomass comes off it as biogenic.

senseible: Upload a season's coal invoices and Senseible gives the kiln's fossil Scope 1 total in minutes, coal at 1.76 kg CO2 per kg; dividing by bricks fired needs your own count.
